mock.name: sort all (pt)

mock.expectation: every part in its rule's bin
mock.final_text: Movi 10 peça(s): 3 defeituosas para a caixa REJECT; 2 azuis para a caixa C; 1 verde para a caixa B; 4 vermelhas para a caixa A.

mock.name: sort all (en)
mock.order: Sort everything by color, defects to reject.
mock.expectation: every part in its rule's bin
mock.final_text: Moved 10 part(s): 3 defective to bin REJECT; 2 green to bin B; 1 blue to bin C; 4 red to bin A.

mock.name: only red to B (en)
mock.order: Only the red ones to bin B.
mock.expectation: red parts in B, the rest untouched
mock.final_text: Moved 2 part(s): 2 red to bin B.

mock.name: only blue to C (pt)
mock.order: Coloque só as peças azuis na caixa C.
mock.expectation: blue parts in C, the rest untouched
mock.final_text: Movi 3 peça(s): 3 azuis para a caixa C.

mock.name: bin D (en)
mock.order: Put the cubes in bin D.
mock.expectation: refuse: nothing moves, the answer names bin D
mock.final_text: I did not run the order: bin D does not exist. The bins are A, B, C and REJECT. Which one should I use?

mock.name: caixa D (pt)
mock.order: Coloque os cubos na caixa D.
mock.expectation: refuse: nothing moves, the answer names bin D
mock.final_text: Não executei a ordem: a caixa D não existe. As caixas são A, B, C e REJECT. Para qual delas devo mandar as peças?

mock.name: ambiguous (en)
mock.expectation: ask: nothing moves, the answer is a question
mock.final_text: I could not tell which parts to move or where. Which parts (red, green, blue, defective or all) and which bin (A, B, C or REJECT)?

mock.name: ambiguous (pt)
mock.expectation: ask: nothing moves, the answer is a question
mock.final_text: Não entendi qual peça mover nem para onde. Quais peças (vermelhas, verdes, azuis, defeituosas ou todas) e para qual caixa (A, B, C ou REJECT)?

mock.name: pare mid-task (pt)
mock.order: Separe todas as peças por cor.
mock.expectation: operator says 'pare' after the first placement: exactly 1 part moved, lamp RED
mock.final_text: Parado pelo operador. A célula está em parada de proteção (lâmpada vermelha).

mock.name: full bin (en)
mock.order: Send the defective parts to reject.
mock.expectation: 4 of 5 defects in REJECT, the 5th left and reported (bin full)
mock.final_text: Moved 4 part(s): 4 defective to bin REJECT. Full bin(s): REJECT; remaining parts were left in place. Refused/failed: 1 (bin REJECT is full).
